coordinate_frame.axes: X east, Y north, Z up
coordinate_frame.transform: Esri EPSG:3857 (WKID 102100/latestWkid 3857) -> WGS84 lon/lat -> local campus approximation X=(lon+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(radians(40.4274)); Y=(lat-40.4274)*111040.0
coordinate_frame.uncertainty: Local campus conversion is approximate, not a surveyed coordinate system. Values are preserved at source precision but should not be interpreted as survey-grade.

sources.feature_identity: FID 905, HCRS, Honors College Residence Hall South, 1101 3rd Street
sources.source_date: GIS feature metadata does not expose a reliable survey or source-capture date; retained raw layer metadata reports a feature layer edit timestamp of 2026-08-31.
sources.measurement_method: Transformed the complete 36-vertex outer ring into campus XY using the project conversion. The ring is used as the building base/wall footprint; dimensions and position are source-derived but locally approximated.
sources.uncertainty: Public building footprints are not survey-grade wall lines. The GIS reports NUM_LEVELS=8 and Extrution=96 with no documented units; these conflict/are ambiguous relative to official Purdue sources stating six stories plus basement, so not used as a measured height.

sources.source_date: Current official housing page; page last crawl showed 2026.
sources.measurement_method: Used to confirm the South Tower is a distinct building in the Honors College and Residences complex and that its housing is pod-style.
sources.uncertainty: No dimensioned elevations or measured exterior dimensions on this page.

sources.provider: John Martinson Honors College, Purdue University
sources.measurement_method: South-specific walking tour identifies the computer collaboratory, community living room/kitchen, reading room, offices, learning studios and STEAM Lab. These confirm broad program distribution, not a measured floor plan.
sources.uncertainty: No dimensioned South floor plan or exterior elevation. Interior geometry in this asset is explicitly schematic and not as-built.

sources.measurement_method: Used official description: six stories plus basement; first floor academic; floors 2-6 residential; basement laundry/game/music. The first level is modeled as a taller academic podium and upper five as residential.
sources.uncertainty: Floor-to-floor heights are estimates; no height measurement is published.

sources.provider: Purdue University News Service / Purdue Today
sources.measurement_method: Visual reference for the complex-wide red-brown brick, dark roof, repetitive framed windows, pale precast articulation, glazed atrium/entry and gable silhouette.
sources.uncertainty: The available image is not independently identified as South-only. Attributing its visible gabled glazed entry composition to South is an inference; this must be graded as uncertain.

sources.source_date: Underlying image capture date is not exposed in the retained export; imagery is current enough to show the completed complex but its exact date is unknown.
sources.crs: WGS 84 (EPSG:4326) export bounds; this is image evidence only, not a footprint source.
sources.measurement_method: Used to confirm the north-south placement relationship of the two Honors buildings and view roof segmentation, setbacks, and rooftop elements. South is the southern building nearer Third Street.
sources.uncertainty: Orthophoto source date unknown; pixels are not used for dimensional measurements.

sources.provider: Fink Roberts & Petrie, project architect/engineer project page
sources.measurement_method: Used project description for five residential floors above a ground academic/support level and concrete podium with upper cold-formed steel framing.
sources.uncertainty: Combined project description covers the full North/South complex, not detailed South-specific elevations.

model_decisions.footprint: Purdue feature 905 outer GIS ring, transformed to the local campus approximation.
model_decisions.stories: Six above-ground modeled floors: 4.15 m academic first-floor podium estimate plus five 3.15 m residential floor estimates. Basement is described by official sources but modeled only as schematic context, not as a measured exposed exterior volume.
model_decisions.roof_height: Estimated eave 19.9 m and modeled roof cap about 20.62 m; not a measured height. A shallow south-facing gable and roof articulation are photo/aerial-informed interpretations.
model_decisions.facade: Procedural brick and modeled window openings, blue-gray glazing, dark metal frames, thin precast story bands, plus an inferred south glazed atrium/entry. Source images are project-wide rather than South-specific.
model_decisions.interior: Generic floor plates, core, and corridor partitions are individually labeled SCHEMATIC INTERIOR / not as-built. Official South tour verifies room functions but not locations or dimensions.
model_decisions.portability: All building materials are procedural; no external image texture paths. Preview camera/lights/ground live outside the exported asset collection.
